title: Can't see the use of the "grill  ridges"
text: Can't see the use of the "grill  ridges". I can't see where this grill pan is beneficial for a grill-look.  It doesn't really do that look efficiently.  So,  if you use it as a regular breakfast egg pan,  the ridges get in the way.  It is big,  and nonstick, and functionable for use when no "grill-look" is needed.
